title: September 29, 2010 Austin City Council Special Called Meeting
meeting_type: Austin City Council Special Called Meeting
transcript:
Closed Caption Log, Council Meeting, 09/29/10 
Note: Since these log files are derived from the Closed Captions created during the Channel 6 live 
cablecasts, there are occasional spelling and grammatical errors. These Closed Caption logs are not 
official records of Council Meetings and cannot be relied on for official purposes. For official 
records or transcripts, please contact the City Clerk at 974-2210. 
  
Mayor Leffingwell: Good morning. I want to call this special meeting of the austin city council to order. 
We're meeting in the council chambers austin city hall, 1 west second street, austin, texas. We will now 
take up item number 1 to approve an ordinance adopting and levys a property or ad valorem tax for city 
of austin for fiscal year 2010-2011. This motion must be made using the words required by the texas 
property tax code. The tax code also requires the vote to be -- vote on this motion to be a roll call vote. 
And my understanding is that councilmember spelman will not be here today so we are proceeding with 
six councilmembers which I assume is okay. So the floor is open for a motion.  
Cole: Valuation which is effectively 1% increase in the tax rate.  
Mayor Leffingwell: Motion by councilmember cole. Is there a second? Seconded by the mayor pro tem. 
Is there any discussion on this item? We have a motion and a second that the property tax rate be 
increased by the adoption of a 71 cents per hundred dollar valuation. gentry, please call the roll on this 
vote.  
Council Member cole.  
Aye.  
Council Member morrison.  
Aye.  
Council Member shade.  
Aye.  
Mayor Leffingwell: That motion passes on a vote of 6-0 with councilmember spelman off the dais. So I 
believe that concludes our agenda for today, so council, without objection, we stand adjourned.
